summary: Frontend-only review of Vinted Manager v1.1 (Expo web preview). Discovered and fixed a critical crash on the Ventes tab caused by missing `monthly` and `bestMonth` declarations in ventes.tsx. After fix, all 4 new features work end-to-end: photo field in stock-new (optional, testID stock-new-image), thumbnail/placeholder rendering in Stock & Action lists, CSV exports (download blob triggered on web for export-stock/ventes/retours with 'Vide' alert on empty data), monthly performances section with best-month subtitle, ROI %, CA, délai. Notifications are web no-op with expected console warning - no crash.
action_items: RCA: ventes.tsx used `monthly` and `bestMonth` in JSX but they were never declared, causing ReferenceError crash on Ventes tab. Fixed by adding useMemo for monthly (computeMonthlyStats(ventes)) and bestMonth (max profit month). Please review fix at /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/ventes.tsx lines 33-38.
critical_code_review_comments: ventes.tsx referenced undeclared variables (monthly, bestMonth). This looked like a merge/copy-paste omission and would have crashed the Ventes screen on first open. Consider adding tsc --noEmit to CI to catch such issues.

ImagePickerField.tsx uses expo-image-picker correctly and handles web (no permission prompt) vs native. base64 payload is stored inline with data:image/jpeg;base64 prefix — fine for small images but could bloat AsyncStorage; consider quality<=0.4 (already set) and reminding user.
csv.ts web path uses Blob + anchor.click() correctly. Good fallback via expo-sharing on native. Minor: the filename embeds Date.now() which is fine but not i18n friendly (ok for internal use).
seed_data_creation: Added 1 TEST stock item 'TEST Jean' (Levi, jean, 10/35€) then marked as Vendu to produce 1 sale for monthly stats verification. Data lives in AsyncStorage (local only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: App URL: https://vinted-stock-hub.preview.emergentagent.com (Expo web preview). Data is AsyncStorage — cleared by Plus → Réinitialiser. Notifications are web-noop by design. CSV exports on web use Blob + anchor download — instrument URL.createObjectURL and HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.click to verify downloads without actually downloading.
rca_of_issue: Ventes crash (bestMonth is not defined) — /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/ventes.tsx JSX referenced `bestMonth` and `monthly` variables that were never declared. Reproduction: open app → tap Ventes tab → red-screen 'Uncaught Error: bestMonth is not defined' at line 74. Mitigation: added `const monthly = useMemo(() => computeMonthlyStats(ventes), [ventes]);` and `const bestMonth = useMemo(() => monthly.reduce((best, m) => m.profit > best.profit ? m : best, monthly[0]) || null, [monthly])`. Verified post-fix: Ventes tab renders Performances mensuelles with month card 'AVR 2026 +25€ / 1 vente / 35€ CA / 0j / 250% ROI' and best-month subtitle.
